```{r}
#install.packages(c("terra", "sf", "rnaturalearth", "spdep", "spatialreg"))

library(terra)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(spdep)
library(spatialreg)
```


```{r}
# 1) Your global GHS raster
r <- rast("/Users/jachym.bielesz/Downloads/GHS_BUILT_S_E2018_GLOBE_R2023A_54009_10_V1_0_R4_C20/GHS_BUILT_S_E2018_GLOBE_R2023A_54009_10_V1_0_R4_C20.tif")
r

# 2) Get Czech Republic polygon (from Natural Earth)
cz_sf <- ne_countries(country = "Czechia",
                      scale = "medium",
                      returnclass = "sf")

# (if "Czechia" doesn't work for your version, try "Czech Republic")
# cz_sf <- ne_countries(country = "Czech Republic",
#                       scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# 3) Reproject CZ to raster's CRS (World Mollweide)
cz_sf_moll <- st_transform(cz_sf, crs(r))

# 4) Convert to SpatVector (terra)
cz_v <- vect(cz_sf_moll)

```

```{r}
# Crop by extent, then mask by country shape
r_cz <- crop(r, cz_v)
r_cz <- mask(r_cz, cz_v)

r_cz
plot(r_cz, main = "GHS Built-up – Czech Republic")

```

```{r}
# Aggregate: 10 m * 100 = 1000 m ≈ 1 km
r_cz_agg <- aggregate(r_cz, fact = 100, fun = "mean")
r_cz_agg
plot(r_cz_agg, main = "Aggregated built-up (1 km cells)")

```


```{r}
# 1) centroid of CZ in Mollweide
cz_center <- centroids(cz_v)   # SpatVector point

# 2) distance raster on the aggregated grid
dist_r <- distance(r_cz_agg)

# 3) centrality = 1 / (1 + distance)
centrality_r <- 1 / (1 + dist_r)

plot(centrality_r, main = "Centrality: inverse distance to CZ centroid")

```



## Praha krimi

```{r}
library(sf)
library(osmdata)
library(sfnetworks)
library(tidygraph)
library(dplyr)
library(h3jsr)
library(spdep)
library(spatialreg)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
# GHSL raster (global, or large region)
ghsl <- rast("/Users/jachym.bielesz/Downloads/GHS_BUILT_S_E2018_GLOBE_R2023A_54009_10_V1_0_R4_C20/GHS_BUILT_S_E2018_GLOBE_R2023A_54009_10_V1_0_R4_C20.tif")

```

```{r}
# Query OSM for the administrative boundary of Prague
prg_query <- opq("Prague, Czechia") |>
  add_osm_feature(key = "boundary", value = "administrative") |>
  add_osm_feature(key = "admin_level", value = "8")  # city-level

prg_osm <- osmdata_sf(prg_query)

# Take the first multipolygon as the city boundary (you can refine if needed)
prague <- prg_osm$osm_multipolygons |> 
  slice(1) |>
  st_make_valid()

st_crs(prague)

```

```{r}
# Match CRS
prague_ghsl_crs <- st_transform(prague, crs(ghsl))

# Crop + mask GHSL raster to Prague boundary
ghsl_prague <- ghsl |>
  crop(prague_ghsl_crs) |>
  mask(prague_ghsl_crs)

```



```{r}
# Work in WGS84 for the OSM query
prague_wgs <- st_transform(prague, 4326)
bb <- st_bbox(prague_wgs)

# Query all highways within Prague bounding box
q_streets <- opq(bbox = bb) |>
  add_osm_feature(key = "highway")

osm_streets_all <- osmdata_sf(q_streets)$osm_lines

# Clip streets to exact Prague boundary
osm_streets_prague <- st_intersection(osm_streets_all, prague_wgs)

```

```{r}
plot(ghsl_prague, main = "Prague: GHSL + OSM Streets")
plot(st_geometry(st_transform(osm_streets_prague, crs(ghsl_prague))),
     add = TRUE, lwd = 0.3)

```

```{r}
# Convert clipped GHSL raster to data.frame for ggplot
ghsl_prague_df <- as.data.frame(ghsl_prague, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
names(ghsl_prague_df)[3] <- "value"  # rename raster column

# Make sure streets are in same CRS as raster (reproject to GHSL CRS)
osm_streets_ghsl <- st_transform(osm_streets_prague, crs(ghsl))

ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = ghsl_prague_df,
              aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value)) +
  geom_sf(data = osm_streets_ghsl, size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = NA) +
  coord_sf() +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Prague streets over GHSL layer",
       fill = "GHSL value")

```


```{r}
## 1) Get Prague boundary from OpenStreetMap ----
prg_query <- opq("Prague, Czechia") |>
  add_osm_feature(key = "boundary", value = "administrative") |>
  add_osm_feature(key = "admin_level", value = "8")   # city-level

prg_osm <- osmdata_sf(prg_query)

# Pick the Prague polygon
prague <- prg_osm$osm_multipolygons |>
  filter(name %in% c("Praha", "Prague")) |>
  slice(1) |>
  st_make_valid()

# Work in WGS84 for OSM queries
prague_wgs <- st_transform(prague, 4326)

## 2) Get Prague streets (highways) ----
bb <- st_bbox(prague_wgs)

q_streets <- opq(bbox = bb) |>
  add_osm_feature(key = "highway")

osm_streets_all <- osmdata_sf(q_streets)$osm_lines

# Clip streets strictly to the Prague polygon
osm_streets_prague <- st_intersection(osm_streets_all, prague_wgs)
```


```{r}
## 3) Plot ONLY the street graph ----
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = osm_streets_prague, linewidth = 0.2) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Street network of Prague (OSM)")

```
```{r}
## 1) Prague boundary ----
prg_query <- opq("Prague, Czechia") |>
  add_osm_feature(key = "boundary", value = "administrative") |>
  add_osm_feature(key = "admin_level", value = "8")

prg_osm <- osmdata_sf(prg_query)

prague <- prg_osm$osm_multipolygons |>
  filter(name %in% c("Praha", "Prague")) |>
  slice(1) |>
  st_make_valid()

prague_wgs <- st_transform(prague, 4326)

## 2) Get Prague streets (edges) ----
bb <- st_bbox(prague_wgs)

q_streets <- opq(bbox = bb) |>
  add_osm_feature(key = "highway")

osm <- osmdata_sf(q_streets)

streets_raw <- osm$osm_lines

# keep only driving / main roads (optional, to reduce size)
#car_highways <- c("motorway", "trunk", "primary", "secondary", "tertiary",
#                  "motorway_link", "trunk_link", "primary_link",
#                  "secondary_link", "tertiary_link", "residential")

streets <- streets_raw |>
  filter(highway %in% car_highways)

# clip to Prague
streets_prague <- st_intersection(streets_raw, prague_wgs)

# clean geometry
streets_prague <- st_make_valid(streets_prague)

```


```{r}
# make an sfnetwork (edges = lines)
# 1) drop geometries that are not LINESTRING/MULTILINESTRING
streets_clean <- streets_prague |> 
  filter(
    st_geometry_type(geometry) %in% c("LINESTRING", "MULTILINESTRING")
  )

# 2) convert MULTILINESTRING → LINESTRING (one row per part)
streets_clean <- streets_clean |> 
  st_cast("LINESTRING")

# 3) drop empty geometries if any
streets_clean <- streets_clean |> 
  filter(!st_is_empty(geometry))

# 4) now build the network
net_prague <- as_sfnetwork(
  streets_clean,
  directed = FALSE,
  edges_as_lines = TRUE
)

net_prague

```


```{r}
# project to a metric CRS so lengths are in meters
net_prague_m <- st_transform(net_prague, 3857)   # Web Mercator (good enough)

net_prague_m <- net_prague_m |>
  activate(edges) |>
  mutate(weight = st_length(geometry))

net_prague_m

```

```{r}
# degree centrality
net_prague_m <- net_prague_m |>
  activate(nodes) |>
  mutate(deg = centrality_degree())

# quick summary
net_prague_m %>%
  activate(nodes) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  summarise(
    mean_deg = mean(deg),
    max_deg  = max(deg),
    n_nodes  = n()
  )

```


```{r}
edges_sf <- net_prague_m %>% 
  activate(edges) %>% 
  st_as_sf()
```


```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = edges_sf, linewidth = 0.2) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Prague street network (geographical)")

```
